wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is entirely BLANK - a real zero, not a gap. Every mark on that page is show-through/bleed from the reverse of the sheet (the page-4 statute text ghosts through in mirror-blurred form); no ruled line carries pen ink in any column. Cover line 1 reads a slashed-Ø zero glyph in ALL THREE columns, and line 2 (the never-itemized $50-or-less aggregate) is likewise Ø in all three, so there is no small-donor aggregate hiding an unitemized amount. Zero rows == cover line 1 THIS (0) == CUMULATIVE (0); the two scopes coincide (this is the filer's only report of the cycle - the LAST-REPORT column is 0 throughout), so scope is recorded cumulative. The Carr form prints NO schedule total on Form A, so the cover line is the only anchor, as the addendum states.

expenditures.detail: One row, 112.75, equals cover line 3 in BOTH the THIS and the CUMULATIVE column (they are equal - first and only report of the cycle, LAST-REPORT column 0), so the two scopes coincide and scope is recorded cumulative. The Carr Form B prints no schedule total; the cover line is the only anchor.

gates.page_subtotal: neither Carr schedule prints a subtotal or a total; p3 row sum 112.75 = cover line 3 (112.75 THIS and CUMULATIVE); p2 row sum 0 = cover line 1 (Ø).
gates.row_count: p3 rowbands.py --dpi 200 returns geometry_status 'gaps' with only 6 bands - the scan is a low-contrast fax-grade image whose ~40 writing rules are mostly not detected, so the tool is NOT usable as the row oracle here (consistent with the standing [DEBT] on it). Counted by ink instead: exactly one inked writing line on p3 (the topmost), one row emitted; zero inked lines on p2, zero rows emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 first-row box (pct:82.29,9.85,13.71,2.58) crops to '$112.75'; it is also the LAST row (single-row side); control one row-pitch below (y 12.42) renders EMPTY (one bare rule plus scanner speckle, no ink).
gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE, and the discrepancy is the FILER's arithmetic, retained verbatim: 0 (beginning) + 0 (contributions) - 112.75 (expenditures) = -112.75, but the filer wrote 112.75 in cover line 4 (balance at end of period) in both the THIS and the CUMULATIVE column - i.e. he entered the expenditure figure unsigned in the balance line. Nothing recomputed or overwritten. No earlier filing by this filer exists in this chunk to chain a prior CUMULATIVE column against.

escalation_note: p3 amount cell at 1200 dpi (confirms $112.75, cramped cents group) plus the empty control crop one pitch below it.
